Jeroboam_1: Solomon's servant, son of Nebat, who rebelled against him (1 Kings 11:26), and was later made king of Israel (1 Kings 12:20)
Nebat_1: father of Jeroboam, an Ephraimite of Zeredah (1 Kings 11:26)
Jehoshaphat_3: son of Asa and King of Judah (1 Kings 15:24)
Ahab_1: son of Omri and King of Israel (1 Kings 16:28)
Elijah_1: the prophet, Tishbite, who was of the settlers of Gilead (1 Kings 17:1)
Elisha_1: anointed prophet in Elijah's place (1 Kings 19:16)
Shaphat_2: father of Elisha the prophet (1 Kings 19:16)
Jehoram_1: King of Judah and son of Jehoshaphat (1 Kings 22:50)
Jehoram_2: King of Israel (2 Kings 1:17) and son of Ahab (2 Kings 3:1)
King of Edom_2: fought with Israel and Judah against Moab (2 Kings 3:9)
